
This guide explains how to install ArenaLytics on a machine that has
**no internet connection**. You will need the file
**`arenalytics_offline_pkgs.zip`** provided by your administrator or a
colleague (see the section *Preparing the bundle* at the bottom if you
are the one creating it). The bundle can be downloaded
[[here]](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BRxiOOwRZll8f8Abh98PGa1eVxG-JWsE?usp=drive_link).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Prerequisites

Make sure the following software is already installed on your machine
before you start.

| Software | Notes |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **R ≥ 4.1** | <https://cran.r-project.org> |
| **RStudio** | <https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/> |
| **Rtools** *(Windows, source bundle only)* | **Not needed** if you use the Windows binary bundle. Only required to compile the source bundle; download the version matching your R from <https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/> |
| **Xcode Command Line Tools** *(macOS only)* | Only for the source bundle. Open the Terminal app and run `xcode-select --install` |
| **Quarto CLI** | Required for report generation. <https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/> |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 1: Create a new R project

1.  Open **RStudio**.
2.  Go to **File › New Project › New Directory › New Project**.
3.  Name the project (e.g. `arenalytics`) and choose a folder on your
    machine.
4.  Click **Create Project**.

You should now be inside a fresh RStudio project with an empty
workspace.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 2: Choose and extract the bundle

Two bundles are available. **Pick one:**

| Bundle | Use when | Speed |
|---|---|---|
| **`arenalytics_offline_pkgs_WIN.zip`** | You are on **Windows with R 4.6.x** | Fast: pre-compiled, no Rtools needed |
| **`arenalytics_offline_pkgs.zip`** | Any other platform (macOS, Linux), or a different R version | Slow: compiled from source, needs a compiler |

> **Windows users should use the `_WIN` bundle.** It contains pre-compiled
> binaries, so installation takes seconds instead of an hour and does **not**
> require Rtools. It only works on R 4.6.x; check yours with
> `R.version.string`.

1.  Copy your chosen zip into the project folder you just created (the same
    folder that contains the `.Rproj` file).
2.  Extract it there:
    - **Windows**: right-click the zip → *Extract All…* → keep the
      default destination.
    - **macOS / Linux**: double-click the zip, or run in the Terminal:

``` bash
unzip arenalytics_offline_pkgs.zip -d arenalytics_offline_pkgs
```

You should now have a sub-folder (`arenalytics_offline_pkgs/` or
`arenalytics_offline_pkgs_WIN/`) laid out as a standard CRAN repository that R
can install from.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 3: Install the packages

Open the RStudio **Console** pane and run the commands for **your** bundle.

### Option A: Windows binary bundle (recommended on Windows)

Install the dependencies first (as pre-compiled binaries), then `arenalytics`
itself (pure R, from its source tarball). Two explicit steps are used because a
single `type = "both"` call does not reliably resolve a local `file://` repo.

```{r install-win}
local_repo <- paste0("file:///", normalizePath("arenalytics_offline_pkgs_WIN", winslash = "/"))

deps <- c(
  "bsicons", "bslib", "DT", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "htmltools", "jsonlite",
  "purrr", "quarto", "rlang", "scales", "shiny", "shiny.i18n", "shinyjs",
  "shinyWidgets", "srvyr", "stringr", "tibble", "tidyr", "zip"
)

# 1. Dependencies as pre-compiled Windows binaries (no compiler, seconds)
install.packages(deps, repos = local_repo, type = "win.binary")

# 2. arenalytics itself (pure R, installs instantly, no Rtools)
install.packages("arenalytics", repos = local_repo, type = "source", dependencies = FALSE)
```

> `dependencies = FALSE` is used because every required package is already
> listed explicitly, so R does not need to resolve (and fail to find) optional
> `Suggests` such as `knitr` and `rmarkdown`.

### Option B: Source bundle (macOS, Linux, other R versions)

```{r install-source}
local_repo <- paste0("file:///", normalizePath("arenalytics_offline_pkgs", winslash = "/"))

install.packages(
  pkgs = c(
    "arenalytics",
    "bsicons", "bslib", "DT", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "htmltools",
    "jsonlite", "purrr", "quarto", "rlang", "scales", "shiny",
    "shiny.i18n", "shinyjs", "shinyWidgets", "srvyr",
    "stringr", "tibble", "tidyr", "zip"
  ),
  repos        = local_repo,
  type         = "source",
  dependencies = FALSE
)
```

> This compiles every package from source and may take **10–60 minutes**.
> A compiler is required (Rtools on Windows, Xcode CLT on macOS). A lot of
> console output is normal.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 4: Launch

```{r launch}
library(arenalytics)
shiny_run_arenalytics()
```

The ArenaLytics dashboard should open in your browser.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Troubleshooting

**`package 'XYZ' is not available`**\
The package was not included in the bundle. Ask your administrator to
regenerate the bundle using `data-raw/make_offline_bundle.R`.

**Installation is very slow / stuck compiling (Windows)**\
You are using the source bundle. Switch to the Windows binary bundle
(`arenalytics_offline_pkgs_WIN.zip`, Option A). It is pre-compiled and
installs in seconds.

**`package 'XYZ' ... is not available` with the Windows bundle**\
Your R version does not match the bundle. The `_WIN` bundle targets R 4.6.x;
check `R.version.string` and either install R 4.6.x or use the source bundle.

**Compilation errors on Windows (source bundle)**\
Rtools is likely missing or the wrong version. Make sure the Rtools
version matches your R version (e.g. Rtools46 for R 4.6.x).

**Compilation errors on macOS**\
Run `xcode-select --install` in the Terminal and retry.

**`could not find function "shiny_run_arenalytics"`**\
The `arenalytics` package itself was not installed. Repeat Step 3.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Preparing the bundle *(for administrators)*

If you are the one providing the bundles, run the following script on a
machine **with** internet access. It downloads all required packages and
their dependencies and produces both bundles:

``` r
source("data-raw/make_offline_bundle.R")
```

This creates, in `data-raw/`:

- `arenalytics_offline_pkgs.zip`: source packages (any platform)
- `arenalytics_offline_pkgs_WIN.zip`: Windows binaries for R 4.6.x

To target a different R version for the Windows bundle, change the `win_ver`
variable near the top of the script. Share the appropriate bundle along with
this vignette with your users.
